suiteTitle: Business Abstraction to Architectural Contract Rubric
description: Evaluates how effectively an agent translates non-technical business promises into rigorous engineering contracts, failure boundaries, and empirical caveats using multi-facet semantic matching.

hiddenKeys.description: Fenced Domain/Payment Projection: Business promise of exactly-once execution translated into at-least-once delivery with storage-fenced domain projections.
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Payments are delivered at-least-once; duplicate or zombie completions are prevented from double-posting by database-level ownership token fencing.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Worker experiences GC pause after initiating external payment API; replacement worker retries while initial worker resumes and attempts ledger commit.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Induce split-brain worker execution; verify ledger record is created exactly once and duplicate write is rejected.

hiddenKeys.description: Explicit 'What Not To Promise' Caveats: Surfaces clear boundaries to business stakeholders (e.g. wall-clock guarantees vs queue backlogs, infinite retries on corrupt payloads).
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Do not promise instantaneous processing under unmetered ingestion; do not promise infinite retries for unparseable input payloads.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Business promises 5-second completion SLA during 100x spike with fixed worker fleet, leading to cascading SLA breach.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Saturate queue to 10x capacity; verify system communicates queue latency degradation rather than dropping messages silently.

hiddenKeys.description: Dual Retry Counters: Distinguishes business logic retries (payment network blip) from poison payload parsing crashes.
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Transient business exceptions retry with exponential backoff; unhandled process crashes increment hard attempt bounds toward DLQ quarantine.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Corrupt document PDF triggers C-extension crash on worker; job loops forever if crash is not counted as an attempt.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Enqueue corrupted document; assert worker crash is recorded at claim time and job enters DLQ after max attempts.

hiddenKeys.description: Storage Saturation Fast Failure: Fast rejection and client backpressure under database/storage lock stalls.
hiddenKeys.business_contract_expected: Ingestion endpoints return HTTP 429/503 when storage queue depth exceeds safety watermark to preserve database health.
hiddenKeys.failure_scenario_expected: Database failover induces 10-second write lock; API servers hold open thousands of client connections and exhaust connection pools.
hiddenKeys.validation_test_expected: Simulate storage connection stall; assert ingestion fails fast within 200ms rather than buffering unbounded requests.
